high_level_description: A 1600x900 relationship diagram on near-white background showing a low oak branch on the left connected by a continuous, dense bridge of red-and-black ladybugs to a single small red tennis ball in the lower-right corner.

style_description.aesthetics: clean, schematic yet organic, minimalistic biological metaphor
style_description.lighting: even, soft ambient light with no shadows

elements.desc: low oak branch: thick horizontal brown rounded rectangle, positioned left, top-aligned near y=220
small red tennis ball: solid red circle, diameter 72px, placed at bottom-right quadrant center (1380,820)
ladybug bridge: 22 individually rendered red-and-black ladybugs aligned along a gentle downward-curving path from branch endpoint to tennis ball center
